How many CPU threads to use. Minimum 1. The maximum is the amount of threads you have (In Node.JS `os.cpus().length`). You can also provide a percentage value (e.g. `50%`).

## CLI flag

```text
--concurrency <value>
```

The following CLI commands accept this option:

- [`remotion studio`](/docs/cli/studio)
- [`remotion render`](/docs/cli/render)
- [`remotion benchmark`](/docs/cli/benchmark)
- [`remotion lambda render`](/docs/lambda/cli/render)
- [`remotion cloudrun render`](/docs/cloudrun/cli/render)

## APIs that have this option

The following APIs accept this option:

- [`renderMediaOnCloudrun()`](/docs/cloudrun/rendermediaoncloudrun#concurrency)
- [`renderMediaOnLambda()`](/docs/lambda/rendermediaonlambda#concurrency)
- [`renderFrames()`](/docs/renderer/render-frames#concurrency)
- [`renderMedia()`](/docs/renderer/render-media#concurrency)

## Config file

```ts twoslash title="remotion.config.ts"
import {Config} from '@remotion/cli/config';
// ---cut---
Config.setConcurrency(8);
```
